sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Prevent accidental non-applicability when iceClass is absent: add a root-level iceClass property constraint requiring exactly one IRI (and preferably sh:class nltl:iceClassValue), so only an explicitly supplied non-applicable class can take the non-applicable branch. Also replace each Ke sh:hasValue decimal check with numeric equality via equal sh:minInclusive and sh:maxInclusive bounds, because RDF-term equality incorrectly rejects equivalent decimal lexical forms such as 1.6 versus 1.60.

rows: Replace the monolithic combinatorial SPARQL witness query with SHACL Core constraints for required cardinalities, datatypes, units, controlled values, positivity, applicability, and the Table 3-1 alternatives, retaining only one bounded SPARQL constraint for the two tolerance-based formula calculations and MCR comparisons. Require exactly one value for each calculation operand/output so that one valid combination cannot hide invalid additional values; preserve the current date/ice-class applicability and the non-exact tolerance comparison for derived powers.

Repair accidental-pass and overconstraint logic: add sh:minCount 1 to the pre-2003 constructionStageDate branch so an applicable-class ship with no date cannot pass as pre-cutoff; do not globally restrict every ship's iceClass to the six listed values, since non-applicable classes must pass the conditional rather than fail an unrelated value-set check. Remove the required but unused brashIceChannelResistanceRch property. Require propellerPitchControlType only for conventional propulsion lookup branches; electric or hydraulic machinery must not need irrelevant pitch evidence. Preserve the UIWL/LIWL-specific resistance operands, Ke table values, bounded formula comparison, and MCR >= both calculated powers.

Prevent accidental non-applicability when iceClass is absent: add a root-level iceClass property constraint requiring exactly one IRI (and preferably sh:class nltl:iceClassValue), so only an explicitly supplied non-applicable class can take the non-applicable branch. Also replace each Ke sh:hasValue decimal check with numeric equality via equal sh:minInclusive and sh:maxInclusive bounds, because RDF-term equality incorrectly rejects equivalent decimal lexical forms such as 1.6 versus 1.60.
